nsc_deal.src: Joint proxy statement / prospectus (Form 424B3 filed 1-Oct-2025 by Union Pacific; NSC DEFM14A 1-Oct-2025): terms, unaudited pro forma condensed combined financial information (Notes 4–7), management assumed synergies; Q3-26 10-Q Note 18 (timing); 8-K 19-Dec-2025 (STB application).
nsc_deal.terms: Each NSC share receives 1.0 UNP share plus $88.82 in cash ($320 per NSC share at announcement). NSC shares outstanding 224,614,894 at 30-Jun-2025 (pro forma basis); UNP shares to be issued ~224.6m plus ~0.3m for equity awards; cash consideration ~$19,950m plus $20m award settlements.

pro_forma.ppa_note: Preliminary PPA at NSC book values except: debt fair-value adjustment −$1,348m (debt due after one year 16,464 → 15,116), related deferred tax +$310m (23.0%), retention bonus accrual +$192m; goodwill $53,078m (residual at the $216.05 UNP price; ±20% UNP price = ±$10bn goodwill). Properties kept at NSC book value ($35,921m): 'once detailed valuations are completed, a material portion could be attributed to properties'; a $10bn property step-up would add ~$275m p.a. of depreciation (2.75% composite rate).
pro_forma.financing: Pro forma assumes the entire cash consideration funded with $19,970m of new debt at 5% plus $190m issuance / liability-management costs (amortized over 15 years); ±0.125% rate = ±$25m annual interest; $5bn of accumulated cash would reduce annual interest by $250m. Merger costs for UNP estimated at $190m.

synergies.capex_phasing: half in year 1, half in year 2 of the phase-in
synergies.stb_application_dec_2025: ~$2.1bn incremental capital to support synergies; $133m annual capital synergies; ~900 net new union jobs by year 3
synergies.phasing_note: Run-rate reached by the third year after closing per the merger announcement materials (8-K 29-Jul-2025 Ex. 99.1 investor presentation); the model phases 25% / 60% / 100% of the net $2.0bn in the first / second / third year after closing (assumption).

nsc_deal.timing: Joint STB application filed 19-Dec-2025; STB decision of 16-Jan-2026 accepted the application as complete (Q3-26 10-Q Note 18); 'currently expected to be completed in the second half of 2027'. Model assumption: closing 1-Jul-2027 (toggle and date inputs).
nsc_deal.shareholder_votes: Approved by UNP and NSC shareholders on 14-Nov-2025 (8-Ks 17-Nov-2025).
nsc_deal.buybacks: UNP share repurchases paused for the merger (Q3-25 release); the model resumes leverage-targeted buybacks only once pro forma leverage falls below the target.
